nodes.label: Offline lessons — create & edit without a connection, sync when it returns
nodes.rationale: Client-generated UUIDs (crypto.randomUUID()) chosen so an offline-created lesson has its final id immediately, making sync a plain idempotent upsert-by-id with no id remapping. Bespoke service worker + IndexedDB mirror + outbox chosen over turnkey sync engines (RxDB/ElectricSQL/PowerSync) because those fight the app's server-only, service-role, owner-scoped-in-code security posture and are disproportionate to a small CRUD offline surface.

nodes.label: Offline support and sync (doc, referenced)
nodes.rationale: Original outbox/mirror design that R5's sync-core extraction must preserve.
